stem: Which graph or table shows the proportional relationship described by the function y = -2x?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph: line passes through points (-4, 4) and (4, -4)

options.label: B
options.text: Graph: line passes through points (-4, 4) and (4, -4), steep negative slope

visual_elements: Graph A: coordinate grid with a positive slope line passing through (-4, -4) and (4, 4)
Graph B: coordinate grid with a negative slope line passing through (-4, 4) and (4, -4)
